description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating an Ooze creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Ooze, adding {1}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
